OPERATIONAL_FLOWS_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Configure the closing flows: the resolution buttons (e.g. Won/Lost), the attributes required at closing time and the events sent to Meta. Assignment rules decide which flow each conversation uses.

API.ERROR_MESSAGE: Could not delete the closing flow

CONFIRM.TITLE: Delete {flowName}?
CONFIRM.MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete this closing flow? The teams and inboxes using it will be left without a flow.

FORM.SUBTITLE: Define the pipeline stages, the closing buttons and what is required when moving or resolving a conversation.

META.LABEL: Send conversions to Meta
META.HELP: Master switch for this flow. When on, each state below can fire a Meta event.

CATEGORY.LABEL: Category
CATEGORY.HELP: Reporting dimension. Sales closings feed the sales funnel; support closings are kept separate and never count as conversions.

PIPELINE.LABEL: Pipeline stages
PIPELINE.HELP: Open kanban columns, in the order a deal moves through them. The Won/Lost states below close the funnel.
PIPELINE.EMPTY: No open stages: this flow works as a closing flow only (Won/Lost).
PIPELINE.DEFAULT_HELP: New deals enter the pipeline in this stage.
PIPELINE.REMOVE_HINT: When a stage is removed, its cards move to the entry stage.

VALUE_ATTRIBUTE.LABEL: Deal value attribute
VALUE_ATTRIBUTE.HELP: Summed per column on the kanban and in the pipeline reports. Conversation attributes of type number, currency or text.

STATES.LABEL: Closing states
STATES.META_NEED_VALUE_ATTR: The Purchase event requires a value. Create a conversation custom attribute of type Number (e.g. "Sale value") under Settings → Custom attributes and select it here.
STATES.META_VALUE_HELP: On save, this attribute becomes required for this state: the agent will be asked to fill it when closing the conversation.

USED_BY.TITLE: This flow is used by:
USED_BY.EMPTY: No team uses this flow yet.

FORM.ERROR_MESSAGE: Could not save the closing flow

REQUIREMENTS.LABEL: Required flow attributes
REQUIREMENTS.HELP: Attributes the agent must fill before moving a card into a stage or resolving as one of the closing states.
REQUIREMENTS.IF_HELP: Only require it when another conversation attribute meets a condition. Combines with the stage chosen above.
REQUIREMENTS.IF_NO_LIST_ATTRS: No multiple-choice (list) attribute available. Create one under Custom attributes.
REQUIREMENTS.IF_NO_ATTRS: No conversation attribute available. Create one under Custom attributes.

TIME_FLOWS.DESCRIPTION: The flow follows the conversation's team: the team assigned to the conversation or, failing that, the team of the agent who handled it. Set which flow each team uses here.
TIME_FLOWS.SAVE_ERROR: We could not update the team's flow
